Meta Test Description: This testcase validates MIPI CSI-2 DPHY lane configuration and data transfer across all lane counts (4 lanes down to 1 lane). The test begins by enabling all CSI-2 host interrupts via the csi2_enable_interrupt() helper function, which reads INT_ST_MAIN to clear pending interrupts and then writes mask values to 10 interrupt mask registers. The virtual channel register is configured based on the GDMA path with VC_ID=3. The D-PHY is initialized via snps_phy_init(). The PHY_STOPSTATE register is polled until it reads 0x1000f. An outer loop iterates lane_num from 3 down to 0, writing each lane count to N_LANES and triggering the CSI-2 sequence. An inner loop iterates over control packets. For each packet DMA channel 0 transfers control data and conditionally DMA channel 1 transfers pixel data based on data type field evaluation.
Test Description: Verify MIPI CSI-2 DPHY lane configuration by iterating through all supported lane counts (4 to 1) and performing CSI-2 control and data packet transfers using DMA. The test enables all CSI-2 host interrupts, initializes the D-PHY, waits for PHY stop state, and for each lane configuration transfers control packets followed by conditional data packets, validating DMA completion via interrupt polling.

12. If data type > 0xf: extract word_count, align to 8 bytes, program DMA ch1, issue DMAGO, poll INTMIS bit 1, clear IRQ.
13. Call finish(0).

Test Description: Verify MIPI CSI-2 internal test pattern generator functionality by configuring the PPI pattern generator with specific vertical/horizontal resolution and data type, enabling it to generate CSI-2 test patterns, and receiving the generated data via DMA transfer.
